connectorUiConfig.title: Exchange Security Insights On-Premises Collector (Azure Monitor)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Connector used to send Exchange Server security configuration data to Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Log Ingestion API.

sampleQueries.description: View the configuration entries available in the table
sampleQueries.query: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL | summarize by GenerationInstanceID_g, EntryDate_s, ESIEnvironment_s

dataTypes.name: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL | summarize Time = max(todatetime(EntryDate_s)) by GenerationInstanceID_g, ESIEnvironment_s  | where isnotempty(Time) |summarize Time = max(Time) | project Time

value: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL | summarize LastLogReceived = max(todatetime(EntryDate_s)) by GenerationInstanceID_g, ESIEnvironment_s |take 1  | project IsConnected = true

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Microsoft Entra
customs.description: Permission to create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID. Typically requires Entra ID Application Developer role or higher.

customs.name: Microsoft Azure
customs.description: Permission to assign the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the Data Collection Rule (DCR). This typically requires the Azure RBAC Owner or User Access Administrator role.

customs.name: Service Account with Organization Management role
customs.description: The service account that runs the scheduled collector task must be a member of the Exchange Organization Management role group.

customs.name: Detailed documentation
customs.description: >**NOTE:** Detailed installation and usage documentation is available [here](https://aka.ms/MicrosoftExchangeSecurityGithub).

parameters.text:
NOTE - UPDATE:

For an existing deployment, update the collector script to version 8.0.0.0 or later, before switching to the Azure Monitor Log Ingestion API.
See ESI On-Premises Collector Update and Upgrade an existing deployment.
For detailed documentation for the following steps, refer to the Official Documentation

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy the Azure Monitor connector resources
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables the Exchange Server collector to send security configuration data to Microsoft Sentinel through the Azure Monitor Log Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Azure Monitor resource deployment
Selecting **Deploy** creates the Log Analytics table, Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), Data Collection Rule (DCR), and Microsoft Entra application required by the collector. Add the collector certificate to this application before configuring certificate authentication.

parameters.label: Deploy Exchange Collector Push connector resources
parameters.applicationDisplayName: Microsoft Exchange On-Premises Collector Push Connector Application

instructionSteps.title: 2. Install the ESI Collector on the Exchange management server
instructionSteps.description: Install the collector on a Windows server that has the Exchange Management Shell, Active Directory module for Windows PowerShell, and at least Az.Accounts module.

instructionSteps.title: Download the latest version of ESI Collector
Copy the script folder
instructionSteps.description: Extract the package and copy the collector folder to a server where the Exchange PowerShell cmdlets are available.

instructionSteps.title: Unblock the downloaded package
instructionSteps.description: Before extraction, run `Unblock-File -LiteralPath .\CollectExchSecIns.zip`. If the package is already extracted, unblock the PowerShell files recursively.

instructionSteps.title: Configure network access
instructionSteps.description: Ensure that the collector can reach Microsoft Entra ID, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com`, and the Data Collection Endpoint displayed by this connector.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Configure the ESI Collector and scheduled task
instructionSteps.description: Run PowerShell as a local administrator and use `WinformConfig\SetupCollectExchSecConfiguration.ps1` to configure the collector and daily scheduled task. Here is the documentation for [WinformConfig](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Microsoft%20Exchange%20Security%20-%20Exchange%20On-Premises/%23%20-%20General%20Content/Documentations/WinformConfigReadme.md). The On-Premises collector uses certificate authentication; using an application secret is an available option but this configuration is not recommended. See the [Certificate creation guide](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Microsoft%20Exchange%20Security%20-%20Exchange%20On-Premises/%23%20-%20General%20Content/Documentations/README_LogIngestionAPI.md#create-the-authentication-certificate).

parameters.label: Data Collection Rule Immutable ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy push connector to get the Data Collection Rule Immutable ID

instructionSteps.title: 4. Verify the mandatoy scheduled task
instructionSteps.description: Verify that WinformConfig created the daily collector task and that it runs under an account in the Exchange **Organization Management** role group. If the task is missing, create it from the **Server Execution** section in WinformConfig.
>**NOTE:** Parsers are automatically deployed with the solution. For additional information, see the [documentation](https://aka.ms/MicrosoftExchangeSecurityGithub).
